WITH counted AS (
  SELECT zoneref, traitcount,
         1.0 * traitcount / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
), ranked AS (
  SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share
  FROM counted
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_code,
       traitcount AS feature_count,
       share,
       share - avg_share AS margin_above_average
FROM ranked
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10
